entries.en: Added `sandbox.filesystem.disabled` setting to skip filesystem isolation while keeping network egress control
entries.zh: 添加了`sandbox.filesystem.disabled`设置以跳过文件系统隔离，同时保持网络出口控制

entries.en: Improved the `/fork` confirmation to one line with the new session's name, `claude attach` id, and a note when the copy shares your checkout
entries.zh: 改进 `/fork` 确认信息：压缩为一行，显示新会话的名称、`claude attach` 的 ID；如果副本与你的工作目录共享，还会加一条说明

entries.en: Improved validation of `git` and `gh` command arguments in the PowerShell tool
entries.zh: 改进 PowerShell 工具中 `git` 和 `gh` 命令参数的校验

entries.en: Improved the `/ultrareview` diff-too-large error to show configured limits, measured diff size, and largest contributing files
entries.zh: 改进 `/ultrareview` 的差异过大报错：会显示已配置的限制、实际测得的差异大小，以及贡献最大的文件

entries.en: Improved `/code-review ultra` empty-diff message to name the exact base ref and suggest passing an explicit base
entries.zh: 改进 `/code-review ultra` 的空差异提示：指明具体的基准分支，并建议显式传入基准分支

entries.en: Improved the spend limit adjustment prompt to show the server's reason when a spend limit change is rejected
entries.zh: 改进消费上限调整提示：服务器拒绝修改消费上限时，会显示服务器给出的原因

entries.en: `/context` now shows an explicit warning when the conversation exceeds the context window, and a failed `/compact` displays as an error
entries.zh: 当对话超过上下文窗口时，`/context` 现在会显示明确警告；`/compact` 失败时会以错误形式显示

entries.en: `/rewind` no longer restores or deletes files through symlinks or hard links at tracked paths and reports how many paths it skipped
entries.zh: `/rewind` 不再通过被追踪路径上的符号链接或硬链接恢复或删除文件，并会报告它跳过了多少路径

entries.en: Background sessions: `/mcp` and `/install-github-app` now park a "needs input" request in the agent view when no client is attached
entries.zh: 后台会话：当没有附加客户端时，`/mcp`和`/install-github-app`现在会在代理视图中放置“需要输入”请求

entries.en: Updated the bundled dataviz skill: reordered the default chart palette and fixed guidance that suggested direct labels for four-series charts
entries.zh: 内置 dataviz 技能：重新排列了默认图表配色，并修正了对四系列图表建议直接标注的错误指导

entries.en: Fixed a slowdown in long sessions where message normalization cost grew quadratically with the number of turns, causing multi-second stalls and slow resumes
entries.zh: 修复了长会话中的速度减慢问题，其中消息标准化成本随轮数呈二次方增长，导致多秒停顿和缓慢恢复

entries.en: Fixed auto mode denying commands with "HTTP 401" classifier errors after the OAuth token expired or rotated mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了 OAuth 令牌过期或在会话中轮换后自动模式拒绝带有“HTTP 401”分类器错误的命令的问题

entries.en: Fixed AskUserQuestion telling Claude to continue even when your answer asked it to wait or explain first — free-text answers now get neutral wording
entries.zh: 修复了 AskUserQuestion 告诉克劳德继续，即使你的答案要求它先等待或解释 - 自由文本答案现在得到中性措辞

entries.en: Fixed Claude Code on the web re-asking the same question and dropping your answer after the session sat idle for a few minutes
entries.zh: 修复了网络上的克劳德代码重新提出相同问题并在会话闲置几分钟后放弃答案的问题

entries.en: Fixed @-mentions silently attaching nothing after file-modifying hooks, vim dot-repeat of `c`-operators and paste, statusline running twice on resume, and resume-picker hangs on failure
entries.zh: 修复了@-提及在文件修改挂钩后无提示附加任何内容、vim 点重复`c`操作符和粘贴、状态行在恢复时运行两次以及恢复选择器在失败时挂起

entries.en: Fixed resumed background agent sessions reverting to the default agent: the agent's prompt and tool restrictions are now restored
entries.zh: 修复了恢复后台代理会话恢复为默认代理的问题：代理的提示和工具限制现已恢复

entries.en: Fixed worktree-isolated subagents redirecting git into the shared checkout via `git -C`, `--git-dir`, or `GIT_DIR`/`GIT_WORK_TREE`
entries.zh: 修复工作树隔离的子智能体通过 `git -C`、`--git-dir` 或 `GIT_DIR`/`GIT_WORK_TREE` 把 git 重定向到共享检出目录的问题

entries.en: Fixed worktree sessions landing in another project's leftover worktree when the working directory did not match the selected project
entries.zh: 修复工作目录与所选项目不匹配时，工作树会话会进入其他项目遗留的工作树的问题

entries.en: Fixed background sessions whose worktree has no git repository being undeletable
entries.zh: 修复了工作树没有 git 存储库的后台会话不可删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude daemon stop --any` potentially terminating an unrelated process via a stale legacy daemon lockfile
entries.zh: 修复了`claude daemon stop --any`可能通过过时的遗留守护进程锁定文件终止不相关进程的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc-Esc at an idle prompt not opening the rewind picker in long-running sessions with background tasks
entries.zh: 修复了在带有后台任务的长时间运行会话中，空闲提示下的 Esc-Esc 未打开倒带选择器的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash command permission checking for compound statements with redirects inside `&&` lists or negations
entries.zh: 修复了对`&&`列表或否定内带有重定向的复合语句的 Bash 命令权限检查

entries.en: Fixed pressing Ctrl+X twice in the agent list failing to delete a session, and deleted sessions reappearing when their background worker had died
entries.zh: 修复了在代理列表中按 Ctrl+X 两次无法删除会话的问题，以及删除的会话在其后台工作人员死亡后重新出现的问题

entries.en: Fixed background subagents getting cancelled when a high-priority message arrives during their startup window
entries.zh: 修复了当高优先级消息在启动窗口期间到达时后台子代理被取消的问题

entries.en: Fixed mouse and focus garbage in the terminal while a GUI editor from `/memory`, `/plan`, `/keybindings`, or Ctrl+G is open; `/memory` no longer waits for the editor to close
entries.zh: 修复了当“/memory”、`/plan`、`/keybindings`或 Ctrl+G 打开 GUI 编辑器时终端中的鼠标和焦点垃圾； `/memory` 不再等待编辑器关闭

entries.en: Fixed Claude-in-Chrome 403-looping on reconnect when the session's OAuth token lacks a required scope
entries.zh: 修复了当会话的 OAuth 令牌缺少所需范围时重新连接时的 Claude-in-Chrome 403 循环

entries.en: Fixed workflow saves and scheduled-task writes following a symlink at `.claude`, which could redirect writes outside the project
entries.zh: 修复工作流保存和定时任务写入会跟随 `.claude` 处的符号链接，可能把写入重定向到项目之外的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP re-authenticate revoking working credentials before the new sign-in succeeds, and the reconnect needs-auth message in background sessions pointing at an unusable command
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP 重新身份验证在新登录成功之前撤销工作凭据，以及后台会话中的重新连接需要身份验证消息指向不可用命令的问题

entries.en: Fixed read-only commands on Windows accessing network paths without a permission prompt
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上的只读命令在没有权限提示的情况下访问网络路径的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bash command parsing of non-ASCII characters to match real shell word boundaries
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 命令解析非 ASCII 字符以匹配真实 shell 字边界的问题

entries.en: Fixed PowerShell tool permission validation of commands containing invisible Unicode characters
entries.zh: 修复了包含不可见 Unicode 字符的命令的 PowerShell 工具权限验证

entries.en: Fixed dialogs in fullscreen mode stretching past the right-hand edge of their panel
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式下的对话框超出面板右侧边缘的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/config` settings list in fullscreen mode clipping its keyboard-hint footer
entries.zh: 修复全屏模式下 `/config` 设置列表的键盘提示页脚被裁切的问题

entries.en: Fixed the transcript-mode (Ctrl+O) footer hint wrapping on terminals narrower than 104 columns
entries.zh: 修复终端宽度小于 104 列时，转录模式（Ctrl+O）页脚提示换行的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Prometheus metrics endpoint (`OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=prometheus`) emitting invalid `# UNIT` lines
entries.zh: 修复 Prometheus 指标端点（`OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=prometheus`）输出无效 `# UNIT` 行的问题

entries.en: Fixed skills and commands changed during a session not appearing in the slash menu until restart
entries.zh: 修复了会话期间更改的技能和命令在重新启动之前不会出现在斜线菜单中的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin skills with a `name` frontmatter field losing their plugin prefix in slash-command autocomplete
entries.zh: 修复了“名称”frontmatter 字段的插件技能在斜杠命令自动完成中丢失插件前缀的问题

entries.en: Fixed telemetry misreporting permission denials: failed permission-prompt requests no longer count as user rejections, and user interrupts are now reported as user aborts instead of rejections
entries.zh: 修复遥测对权限拒绝的误报：失败的权限提示请求不再计为用户拒绝，用户中断现在记为用户中止而非拒绝

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed right-to-left text (Arabic, Hebrew, Persian) rendering in the wrong order when mixed with English or code
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复右到左文本（阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语）与英文或代码混排时顺序错乱的问题

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions dropping the in-flight message when the session's container restarts mid-turn — the interrupted turn now re-runs on resume instead of leaving the session unresponsive
entries.zh: 修复了云会话在会话的容器在中途重新启动时丢弃运行中消息的问题 - 中断的轮次现在会在恢复时重新运行，而不是让会话无响应
